## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain checks that could not run.
For UI changes, include screenshots; for SQL behavior, include a small scenario when useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated behavior.
- [ ] Relevant behavior or regressions are covered by tests.
- [ ] Documentation and the Unreleased changelog describe user-visible changes.
- [ ] Shared logs and artifacts contain no launch tokens, secrets or private data.
- [ ] SQLite experiments use only disposable databases owned by TxnStage.

Disclose any dependency, artifact-format or security-boundary change and explain why it is needed.
